nodes.data: The Potent Sulfur block no longer crafts back into Sulfur blocks
Updated the textures for the following blocks:
Can no longer be picked up by Boats
Updated sounds for Nautilus jets and Nautilus recovers
The Data Pack version is now 102.0
The Resource Pack version is now 86.0
Entity predicate format has changed from a structure with multiple optional fields to one similar to data component maps.
In this version it has become a component-like sub-predicate entry:
All keys in entity predicates are now identifiers
Since identifiers can be written without namespace (default to
namespace), existing field names are still valid
Unrecognized sub-predicate components are now rejected (previously unknown fields were ignored)
Existing type-specific sub-predicates have been renamed and moved to top-level.
as it now includes Sulfur Cubes in addition to Slimes and Magma Cubes
This predicate matches entity tags (i.e. ones set with the
- optional list of strings, if present the matched entity must have at least one of the listed tags
- optional list of strings, if present the matched entity must have all the listed tags
- optional list of strings, if present the matched entity must have none of the listed tags
- Block Predicate, describes which blocks this feature can be placed on
- Block Predicate, describes which blocks this feature can replace with air or the provided
- Block Predicate, describes which blocks this feature can replace with the provided
for blocks which are speleothems like Pointed Dripstone and Sulfur Spike

with the respective bed's color's name
special model type has been removed

bugList.title: Picking up an axolotl with a lead attached destroys the lead
Blocks with emissive textures don't emit much light when held by endermen
Glowing dragon fireballs no longer show the glowing outline
Enabling JFR profiling causes the client to crash on startup
Using an empty Offers NBT tag to disable trades doesn't work after a relog/data merge
Polished sulfur is named "Polished Sulfur Block", which is inconsistent with all other polished stone blocks
The game crashes when an entity with the friction_modifier attribute set to 2.5 moves
Sulfur cubes with blocks inside them produce footstep sounds when moving across the ground
Magma blocks held by sulfur cubes are not emissive
Frogs try to eat large magma cubes now
Magma cubes no longer drop magma cream
The bottom face of slimes' outer layer z-fights with the ground
Releasing a sulfur cube from a bucket and killing it does not cause it to drop its held block
Sulfur cubes don't emit light when holding a glowing block
The #sulfur_cube_archetype/fast_flat item tag contains pumpkin twice
When picking up a leashed sulfur cube with a bucket, the lead disappears
The game now renders fluid faces that should not be rendered
The block breaking texture on bamboo stalks is now always displayed centered
Emptying a sulfur cube bucket underwater doesn't place the sulfur cube at the targeted block
